# Changelog

What changed in each release.

## Unreleased

- **Nothing yet.**

## v0.5.0 — 2026-10-27

Pick where a session runs, drop files into the composer, and get told when an
agent needs you.

### New
- **Where it runs.** A picker for the machine, folder and branch, with
  [last seen](docs/guide.md#machines) times.
- **Attachments.** Drag, drop or paste files into the composer; they upload
  before the agent starts.

### Fixed
- Sessions no longer start in a folder that was deleted.

## v0.4.0 — 2026-10-20

Skills and plugins in one place.

### New
- **Skills & plugins.** One page for everything that extends an agent, with `code`.

## v0.4.0-rc.1 — 2026-10-18

Preview.

## v0.3.9 - 2026-10-01
